summary: Namib Minerals furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated September 21, 2026, announcing completion of the dewatering programme at its Redwing Mine in Zimbabwe, the first of a five-step restart pathway published July 20, 2026, delivered ahead of the targeted Q4 2026 schedule. The company reports Step 2, a fully funded Definitive Feasibility Study technical programme, is underway and on track for early Q1 2027. No transaction, securities offering, or change of control is involved; this is an operational milestone update with no deal terms to arbitrage.
